name: Image Background
description: Turns a picture into editor objects (painted with overlapping shapes), so it can be used as a level background.

style.name: Style
style.description: painting = soft overlapping brush strokes, looks like a real picture. pixels = a grid of squares.

strokes.name: Painting: strokes
strokes.description: How many brush strokes (= objects). More = more detail. 600 is a good start, 2000 is very detailed.

size.name: Painting: width in blocks
size.description: How wide the finished picture is, in blocks.

width.name: Pixels: width (cells)
width.description: How many squares wide the picture is. More = sharper, but more objects.

cell.name: Pixels: cell size
cell.description: Size of one square in units (a block is 30). Picture width = width x cell size.

colors.name: Pixels: colour detail (1-5)
colors.description: Lower = fewer different colours, so more squares merge into long bars and the object count drops.

group.name: Group ID
group.description: Every square gets this group (0 = none), so one Move trigger can move the whole picture.

editor-layer.name: Editor layer
editor-layer.description: Editor layer the squares are put on, so the picture can be hidden or locked.
